init_NSPBertModel: initialize NSPBertModel with model_dir and data_dir to load a pretrained semantic parsing model
parse_chat_to_logical_form: parse a chat string into a logical form dict using NSPBertModel parse method
load_model_from_checkpoint: load a pretrained model checkpoint, tree vocabulary, and args from a model directory
build_encoder_decoder_model: build an encoder-decoder transformer model with BERT encoder and decoder with loss
run_beam_search_decoding: run beam search decoding on chat input to generate the best logical form tree
